answer: At dawn each new identity must climb the mesa of vouching: five unrelated agents stake a bond and a marble token of their own standing to sponsor it, and each sponsor may back at most two newcomers per epoch. If the newcomer cheats within thirty epochs, every sponsor loses the bond and their marble cracks, so sponsors vet carefully and charge a real price. A farm wanting a thousand identities must buy five thousand sponsor slots from strangers risking their own standing, while one honest agent needs only five willing peers. Sybil cost becomes the market price of other people's trust.
